title: FormInv: A Measurement Protocol for Semantic Invariance in Mathematical Reasoning Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2605.29001v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A paraphrase-quality audit of MathCheck (ICLR 2025) detected 4 semantically incorrect paraphrases in 129 groups (3.1%); removing them drops GPT-4o from rank 2 to rank 4 and elevates Claude Haiku and DeepSeek V3 above it. Cross-model unanimity found these errors automatically for under $10; in our own dataset the same protocol found that 47% of auto-generated connective-variation paraphrases were semantically incorrect. That flaw compounds a deeper measurement gap. On the theorems every model answers correctly in canonical form, a semantically equivalent rewording still flips the answer for 5-42% of them: Claude Haiku 4.5 flips a known-correct answer about 9x as often as DeepSeek V3 (41.9% vs. 4.7% on the 43 theorems all models share), a difficulty-controlled gap we call the Conditional Inconsistency Rate (CIR). The CIR ranking replicates on an independent 103-theorem set. Raw Semantic Consistency Rates (SCR) span 50-82% across

translated_title: FormInv：数学推理基准中语义不变性的测量协议
translated_abstract: 对MathCheck（ICLR 2025）改写质量的审计在129个组中发现了4个语义错误的改写（3.1%）；移除这些错误后，GPT-4o的排名从第2位降至第4位，而Claude Haiku和DeepSeek V3则升至其上。利用跨模型一致性方法，这些错误在不到10美元的成本下被自动发现；在我们自己的数据集中，同一协议发现47%自动生成的连接词变化改写在语义上是错误的。这一缺陷还加剧了一个更深层的测量差距：在所有模型都能以规范形式正确回答的定理上，语义等价的改写仍会使其中5-42%的答案发生翻转；在所有模型共享的43个定理上，Claude Haiku 4.5翻转已知正确答案的频率约为DeepSeek V3的9倍（41.9%对4.7%），我们将这一难度受控的差距称为条件不一致率（CIR）。CIR排名在一个独立的103个定理集合上得到了复现。原始语义一致性率（SCR）在各模型之间的范围为50-82%（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出FormInv测量协议，用于审计数学推理基准中自动生成改写题目的语义等价性，并引入条件不一致率（CIR）指标，揭示即使在所有模型都能正确回答的规范形式定理上，语义等价的改写仍会导致5-42%的答案翻转。
en_tdlr: FormInv is a measurement protocol for auditing semantic equivalence of paraphrases in mathematical reasoning benchmarks, which introduces the Conditional Inconsistency Rate (CIR) and reveals that semantically equivalent rewordings flip 5-42% of answers even on theorems that all models answer correctly in canonical form.
